title: Straight-talking
slide_intent: Teach writers to communicate one point in everyday language. A person outside the sector should be able to follow a sensitive issue without specialist vocabulary.
strategic_value: Clear phrasing can make the organization’s position accessible while preserving the facts and dignity of the people involved.
demonstration: The first numbered principle defines directness, describes the sound of plain speech and gives a read-aloud test. A separate column turns the principle into writing practices.
practical_value: Read a sentence aloud, identify its central point, and replace any sector term that an unfamiliar reader would need explained.

content_islands.name: Principle identifier
content_islands.spec: Mark Straight-talking in the chapter rail. Pair the large pale numeral 1 with its pink nameplate and the cyan underline.

content_islands.name: Definition and limits
content_islands.spec: Use the central column for a definition, a prose example of the approach and its boundaries, including sensitivity and sufficient detail.

content_islands.name: Writing guidance
content_islands.spec: Place a short writing checklist at right. Include the doctor or nurse analogy and the read-aloud check.
